intent: FOH owner foh-hev-kit-20261029; reply macbook/foh-hev. Adam reviewed the local kit dashboard (hev serve, internal/serve) on 2026-10-29 and asked for this change. Work only in this kit clone on the branch you are given; commit your candidate with a clear message. Do not push, merge, deploy, release, restart shared services, write to any live Layer/turbopuffer archive namespace, resolve new credentials, spawn workers or accept your own work. Preserve unrelated files. Finish with a short report: what changed, why, tests run and their output, the candidate commit, and anything you could not do. GOAL: most traces in the dashboard show no summary, which makes the trace list and trace view hard to read. Evidence from the laptop archive (GET /api/sessions, last 30 days, 2026-10-29): 5,912 sessions; only 295 have a non-empty summary, and all 295 are claude_code sessions with summary_backfilled=false (the harness's own summary). The other 5,617 (claude_code 2,804, codex 2,746, dot 44, pi 23) have summary_backfilled=true but an EMPTY summary. So the enrichment/backfill path marks sessions summarized without writing a summary. Find the root cause in the backfill/enrichment and summary code (cmd/hev/backfill*.go, internal/layer/backfill*.go, internal/index/summary*, docs/session-backfill.md, internal/serve) and fix it so every harness gets a short (1-2 line) plain-language summary of what the session did, derived the way kit already intends (read the docs; use the existing configured summarizer path, do not add a new provider or credential). A session that genuinely cannot be summarized must carry an explicit reason, never a blank marked as done; summary_backfilled must not be true for an empty summary. The dashboard trace list and trace view must show the summary (and the reason when absent). Add tests that would have caught the empty-but-backfilled state. If the existing archive needs a re-backfill to repair the 5,617 sessions, implement and document the repair (dry-run/preview first) but DO NOT run --apply against a live namespace; FOH runs that rollout after independent validation.
